description: Route this task correctly when the matching category shuttle is disabled. The file being changed is `src/4.Presentation/DST.Client/Components/Settings.tsx`. The active Weave config declares a client-frontend category covering `src/4.Presentation/DST.Client/`, which would normally route to `shuttle-client-frontend`. However, the config also includes `disable agents ["shuttle-client-frontend"]`. Which agent should now handle this work?

categories.name: client-frontend
categories.description: Client frontend: UI components, pages, hooks, and utilities under src/4.Presentation/DST.Client/
triggers: Use for changes to files under src/4.Presentation/DST.Client/
